title: Crashes immediately

title: An unexpected treasure
body: This app has been surprisingly delightful. The songs are not my jam but just as the app and science behind it explains, the frequencies match what I need at the time. I have used it now for household duties, study, and sleep and it’s worked each time. I absolutely recommend trying it out asap.

author: John484639

title: New update bug
body:
Love this app and have used it for sleep for years. Highly recommend. 

Just some feedback on the latest update. Since the update, the sleep tracks (i haven’t checked the other categories) won’t play beyond a hour. Hope this will be remedied in a future update!
author: MezzyHa

title: The app is amazing
body:
The app is amazing, it changed the way I’m working. It brought me more concentration, better productivity and happier mood, aka more flow state in work.

And they keeps improving the app, UI, experience, bringing new features like meditation.

Great work and keep it going.

title: Brilliant for work!
body: I use this when I need to focus on my work and it’s always helped.  Highly recommended.
author: Fredinski

title: A complete scam
body:
Great product but they scam you into signing up for a subscription and then fail to honour it.
I paid for a 12 month subscription for $75, but despite numerous emails to Brain FM and Apple I still have no Service and no response to say they’re resolving it.
Stay clear of this fraudulent app!
